home.hero_quote: Doing Nothing is Not An Option of Our Life
home.mct_intro: Maharshi Charitable Trust was started in 2013 by Sri Bhagavan Swami Ramananda Yogi Chandrulu in Mellacheruvu village, Pileru Mandal, Chittoor District, Andhra Pradesh.
home.vision_text: Fundamental vision of Maharshi Charitable Trust (MCT) is to offer the science of inner wellbeing to every human being, a science that helps a person realize the ultimate potential within. From this vision stem a multitude of projects, programs, and methods, all towards the same aim: to raise every human being to the peak of their potential.
home.volunteer_text: Everybody can be great. Because anybody can serve. You don't have to have a college degree to serve. You only need a heart full of grace. MCT is heartily inviting the volunteers who are ready to participate in all our charity events and trust activities.
home.sponsor_text: As we are trying to give a better future for the remote villages by providing necessary needs, water supply, medical camps, free skill-based training to the rural youth. We are requesting the sponsors to come forward and involve in our trust activities.

about.title: About Us
about.objectives_text1: The main objective of MCT is to serve the people and conducting welfare activities like water supply, Books distribution to the children, Arranging Health Camps, Training centers for Youth, Providing facilities to the remote villages etc.
about.objectives_text2: The ideology of MCT includes eternal principles of vedas. Realization of god within the self is the ultimate goal of human being. Serving the people is serving the god.
about.activities_text1: To implement the activities that are purely charitable/non-religious in nature and not motivated for profit of the Trust that shall be irrevocable.
about.activities_text2: To introduce yoga Practices which can benefit your state of mind, body and soul which will be helpful in building healthy world.
about.activities_text3: Truthfulness and honesty are the pillars of MCT. The activities will cover different areas of social welfare which includes educational services, rural development services, spiritual activities and protection of environment.
future: Dinner Hall At Rajampet MCT Temple
Dinner Hall At Badvel Near MCT Shanthi Nilayam
about.outreach_plantation_desc: Project Plantation is an environmental revolution of an inspired public that aims to increase the green cover of an entire state, restoring soil health and healing the impact of climate change.
about.outreach_rural_desc: As the people in remote villages are facing several problems without having proper facilities, we are supporting them by providing necessary facilities.
about.outreach_school_desc: Every Year under Maharshi Charitable Trust, books are distributed to school students in Mellacheruvu Village, Pileru.
about.edu_veda_desc: In this program, we are teaching Vedas to the children and explaining the effect of Vedas in our day to day life. The Vedas help humans to know their essential nature and return to their eternal state as liberated souls.
about.edu_geetha_desc: In this program, we are teaching Geetha to the students, which clarifies why it is an all-inclusive wellspring of motivation. It stands the trial of time and circumstance.
about.edu_welfare_desc: MCT also performs socio welfare activities in nearby villages of Pileru Mandal which includes distribution of blankets, clothes, uniforms, books and stationery to school children.

milestones.event: Trust founded by Sri Bhagavan Swami Ramananda Yogi Chandrulu at Mellacheruvu, Chittoor District, Andhra Pradesh.
Nithya Annadhana Seva (daily free meals) programme launched at Mellacheruvu.
Free Drinking Water supply programme started for rural villages.
Books distribution programme launched for children in Mellacheruvu.
Yoga and meditation training centres established at Mellacheruvu and K.V. Palli.
MCT Meditation Hall at Rajampet inaugurated.
MCT Meditation Hall at Badvel and Chittathur established.
COVID-19 relief operations — food & essentials distributed to needy families.
Goshala (cow shelter) and Swachh Bharat cleanliness drives initiated.
Annual Rathostavam and Varuna Yagnam conducted with thousands of devotees.
Rural development projects — CC Roads, water supply and tree plantation drives.
